comments.text: Every person is a person. A country that uses an indigenous language (Sango) as its official tongue to unite over 80 ethnic groups instead of defaulting to the colonizer's language. Such a magnificent spirit hidden within one of the most isolated nations on Earth! 🇨🇫✨

replies.author: @BestTravelDocumentary4k
replies.text: Spot on! The unity built through Sango across so many ethnic groups is truly inspiring. Do you enjoy studying indigenous languages and cultural histories?"
